name: We're Women, After All
source:
The Ash Mermaid gives you a knife. She knows the pain your family gives you. Just kill them already.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/were-women-after-all]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灰烬美人鱼给你一把刀。她知道你的家人给你带来的痛苦。干脆杀掉他们吧。
